{{Top}}
'''Skirtopanol''' was a truth serum for interrogating prisoners. Its effects were not just loosening up a subject, but causing greater sensitivity to make [[Torture/Legends|torture]] more effective. Progressively higher doses were used with torture during narco-interrogation. Skirtopanol could be lethally counteracted by [[lotiramine]].
